name: 3P - fulfillment timeline
steps: Open Online Store > Themes > Customize for an unpublished copy. Choose the page template, select Add section, and choose 3P - fulfillment timeline.
Select Add block inside this section. Use the supported block types listed below, then drag them into the desired reading order.
Connect your own content and media before adjusting layout, typography, color, and spacing. Section overrides take priority where the section offers them.
Preview desktop and mobile, test any links or controls, and save. Publish only after reviewing the complete customer journey.

settings.content: Static content only. Enter your actual fulfillment steps and current estimates; no shipping system updates these values automatically. Header colors follow the chosen theme surface; the color controls below apply to cards and their details.
